pages.text: $(item)Bundled Sticks$() are a crafting component. The Auram pack replaces many wooden-stick recipe inputs with bundles. Check JEI for the recipe and output in your installed pack; pack scripts can replace the built-in recipe.

$(item)Ender Jade$() and $(item)Journey Map$() are integration items. Their item classes do not grant powers or open a map on their own. Recipes, stages, and access rules belong to the installed pack scripts.$(br2)This guide documents AuramCore. Other Auram mods and pack scripts can add their own rules.
